name: Have you ensured that other organisations you plan to share data with as part of the service delivery are compliant with the relevant cyber security obligations?
conditionsText: Any service that shares data with another organisation
requirementTitle: Have you ensured that other organisations you plan to share data with as part of the service delivery are compliant with the relevant cyber security obligations?
requirementDescription: Before sharing information with another organisation, have you checked they meet the required security standards?
why:
Your security obligations do not disappear when data leaves your organisation.
The receiving organisation must also be capable of protecting the information appropriately.
